documentation_excerpts.text: Toxiproxy is a framework for simulating network conditions. It's made specifically to work in testing, CI and development environments, supporting deterministic tampering with connections, but with support for randomized chaos and customization. **Toxiproxy is the tool you need to prove with tests that your application doesn't have single points of failure.** We've been successfully using it in all development and test environments at Shopify since October, 2014. See our [blog post][blog] on res

Toxiproxy usage consists of two parts. A TCP proxy written in Go (what this repository contains) and a client communicating with the proxy over HTTP. You configure your application to make all test connections go through Toxiproxy and can then manipulate their health via HTTP. See [Usage](#usage) below on how to set up your project.
